questions.question: 消费最高的10个客户分别买了哪些品类？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total
  FROM orders o GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT c.name AS customer, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cat.name) AS categories
FROM top10 t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY MAX(t.total) DESC

questions.question: 从2025年6月到2026年5月（共12个自然月），每个月的新增客户数和订单量分别是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym
  FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-06-01'
),
new_cust AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', register_date) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
  FROM customers WHERE register_date >= '2025-06-01' AND register_date < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY ym
),
ord_cnt AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY ym
)
SELECT m.ym AS month,
       COALESCE(nc.new_customers, 0) AS new_customers,
       COALESCE(oc.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN new_cust nc ON nc.ym = m.ym
LEFT JOIN ord_cnt oc ON oc.ym = m.ym
ORDER BY m.ym

questions.question: 退货率最高的3个品类，它们的供应商有哪些？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH cat_stats AS (
  SELECT p.category_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS return_cnt,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
         CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS REAL)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS rate
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY p.category_id
  ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 3
)
SELECT cat.name AS category, s.name AS supplier
FROM cat_stats cs
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = cs.category_id
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cs.category_id
JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
GROUP BY cat.name, s.name
ORDER BY cat.name, s.name

questions.question: 评分高于全站平均分的商品中，哪些库存不足50件？给出它们的供应商
questions.gold_sql:
WITH avg_rating AS (SELECT AVG(rating) AS v FROM reviews),
prod_rating AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.stock, p.supplier_id, AVG(r.rating) AS r_avg
  FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
)
SELECT pr.name AS product, s.name AS supplier
FROM prod_rating pr
JOIN avg_rating a ON pr.r_avg > a.v
JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = pr.supplier_id
WHERE pr.stock < 50
ORDER BY pr.name

questions.question: 复购率最高的3个大区，它们的平均客单价是多少？复购率 = 下过至少2次订单的客户数 ÷ 全部客户数；平均客单价 = 该大区所有订单 total_amount 的平均值。
questions.gold_sql:
WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.region_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.region_id
),
region_rate AS (
  SELECT region_id, COUNT(*) AS customers,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_cust,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
           / COUNT(*) AS repeat_rate
  FROM cust_orders GROUP BY region_id
),
top3 AS (SELECT region_id FROM region_rate
         ORDER BY repeat_rate DESC, region_id LIMIT 3)
SELECT r.name AS region, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM top3 t
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = t.region_id
JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = t.region_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY r.name
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

questions.question: 各品类中销售额排名前3的商品，它们的月均销量是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH prod_sales AS (
  SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.name,
         SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS sales
  FROM products p JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id
      ORDER BY sales DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_sales
),
top3 AS (SELECT product_id, name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3)
SELECT t.name AS product,
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(od.quantity) AS REAL)
             / COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)), 2) AS monthly_avg_qty
FROM top3 t
JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY t.product_id, t.name
ORDER BY monthly_avg_qty DESC

questions.question: 从未退货的客户里，消费总额最高的5位分别买了哪些品类？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH never_returned AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
  FROM customers c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id)
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT nr.customer_id, nr.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total
  FROM never_returned nr JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = nr.customer_id
  GROUP BY nr.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
)
SELECT t.name AS customer, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cat.name) AS categories
FROM top5 t
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.name
ORDER BY MAX(t.total) DESC

questions.question: 按销售额降序排列，累计销售额首次达到全站总销售额80%时包含多少个商品？这些商品占全部库存总价值的百分之多少？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH prod_sales AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.stock, p.cost,
         SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS sales
  FROM products p JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(sales) AS s FROM prod_sales),
cum AS (
  SELECT ps.*, SUM(ps.sales) OVER (ORDER BY ps.sales DESC
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_sales
  FROM prod_sales ps
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(cum_sales) AS t80 FROM cum, tot WHERE cum_sales >= s * 0.8
),
in_pareto AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM cum c, threshold th WHERE c.cum_sales <= th.t80
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM in_pareto) AS pareto_product_count,
       ROUND((SELECT SUM(stock * cost) FROM in_pareto)
             * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(stock * cost) FROM prod_sales), 2) AS pct_of_inventory_value

questions.question: 签收率最低的3家物流公司，它们配送的订单主要来自哪些城市？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH ship_rate AS (
  SELECT s.shipper_id, s.name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT st.track_id) AS track_cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = '已签收' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signed_cnt
  FROM shippers s
  JOIN orders o ON o.shipper_id = s.shipper_id
  JOIN shipping_tracking st ON st.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY s.shipper_id
),
rate AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(signed_cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(track_cnt, 0) AS sign_rate
  FROM ship_rate ORDER BY sign_rate ASC, name LIMIT 3
),
city_orders AS (
  SELECT r.name AS shipper, c.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM rate r
  JOIN orders o ON o.shipper_id = r.shipper_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY r.name, c.city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shipper
      ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, city) AS rn
  FROM city_orders
)
SELECT shipper, city, order_cnt
FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY shipper, rn

questions.question: 2025年销售额环比下滑月份最多的品类有哪些，它们的退货率是多少？
questions.gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.category_id, strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
         SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price) AS sales
  FROM products p
  JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.category_id, ym
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT *, LAG(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY ym) AS prev_sales
  FROM monthly
),
declining AS (
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS decline_months
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE prev_sales IS NOT NULL AND sales < prev_sales
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT cat.name AS category, d.decline_months,
       ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS REAL)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM declining d
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = d.category_id
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = d.category_id
JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cat.name, d.decline_months
ORDER BY d.decline_months DESC, cat.name
